items.title: Why the Nasdaq Refuses to Break Even With Treasury Yields Above Five Percent
items.summary: The ten-year Treasury yield just hit levels that should be crushing growth stocks, yet the Nasdaq-100 keeps refusing to fall. The reason comes down to six companies whose balance sheets are rewriting the rules of how rate pressure actually transmits.

items.title: AI’s $10 Trillion Buildout Will Reach 3.6% of GDP. Who’s Going to Pay for It?
items.summary: Big Tech is funneling nearly $200 billion into AI infrastructure every single quarter, a share of the economy larger than the entire railroad expansion. But the balance sheets tell a more complicated story about who is actually footing the bill.
